report_comment.text: RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis. RUNX1T1 encodes ETO, a transcriptional corepressor. RUNX1::RUNX1T1 (AML1-ETO) promotes serial replating of murine hematopoietic progenitors. DNA-binding disruption or deletion of its NHR2 oligomerization region abolished this transforming activity in the tested model. Under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria, RUNX1::RUNX1T1 AML is assigned to the favorable genetic-risk group.
